questions.question: Which Performance Analytics feature supports domain separation for collecting scores from multiple domains?

explanation.correct: Domain separation is supported for Performance Analytics. Domain separation enables you to separate data, processes, and administrative tasks into logical groupings called domains. Performance Analytics supports collecting scores from multiple domains and can be configured to enable domain-specific administration.

wrongAnswers.explanation: KPI Composer is for designing PA solutions, not domain separation.
Analytics Hub is for viewing indicator data, not managing domains.
Spotlight is for record ranking, not domain separation.

source.excerpt: Domain separation is supported for Performance Analytics. Domain separation enables you to separate data, processes, and administrative tasks into logical groupings called domains. Performance Analytics supports collecting scores from multiple domains and can be configured to enable domain-specific administration.

questions.question: What does the Performance Analytics Integration capability allow?

options.text: Only importing data from external systems
Collecting scores based on remote data or exposing Analytics Hub information to external systems
Connecting only to other ServiceNow instances

explanation.correct: Integrate Performance Analytics with an external system to collect scores based on remote data or to expose Analytics Hub information.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Integration supports both importing remote data AND exposing PA information externally.
PDF export is separate from the integration feature with external systems.
Integration works with external systems generally, not just other ServiceNow instances.

source.excerpt: Integrate Performance Analytics with an external system to collect scores based on remote data or to expose Analytics Hub information.

questions.question: Which two scripting capabilities are provided by Performance Analytics? (Choose two.)

options.text: Script objects for use in breakdown mappings
APIs for querying Performance Analytics data

explanation.correct: Performance Analytics provides several script objects for use in scripts and APIs for querying Performance Analytics data. The scripts serve as breakdown mappings or to calculate a value from an indicator.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Indicators must be created through configuration, not automatic scripts.
Table structure modifications are platform-level, not PA scripting capabilities.

source.excerpt: Performance Analytics provides several script objects for use in scripts and APIs for querying Performance Analytics data. The scripts serve as breakdown mappings or to calculate a value from an indicator.

questions.question: Which two roles can access the Performance Analytics Admin Console? (Choose two.)

explanation.correct: Users with the admin or pa_admin roles can navigate to Performance Analytics > Admin Console.

wrongAnswers.explanation: pa_viewer and pa_power_user cannot access the Admin Console.
pa_data_collector and pa_viewer do not have Admin Console access.
itil and pa_contributor do not have Admin Console access.

questions.question: Which two panels are available in the Performance Analytics Admin Console for identifying issues? (Choose two.)

options.text: Troubleshoot — for diagnostic errors and failed data collection jobs
Usage — for data collection and report usage dashboards

explanation.correct: The Admin Console includes Troubleshoot (diagnostic errors and failed jobs) and Usage (data collection overview and reports usage dashboards) panels for issue identification.

wrongAnswers.explanation: There is no Audit panel in the PA Admin Console.
There is no Compliance panel in the PA Admin Console.

questions.question: What does the Dependency Assessment feature in Performance Analytics allow administrators to do?

options.text: View, analyze, and edit PA components and their relationships from a single view
Check dependencies between PA plugins before activation
Evaluate the impact of upgrading to a new ServiceNow release

explanation.correct: Dependency Assessment enables administrators to view, analyze, and edit PA components including widgets, indicators, and breakdowns from a single view, showing hierarchy and relationships to understand the impact of changes.

wrongAnswers.explanation: It assesses relationships between PA components, not instances.
It is not a plugin dependency checker.
It is for day-to-day component management, not release upgrades.

questions.question: An administrator wants to restrict a dashboard so only users with the 'itil' role can view it. What must be done BEFORE setting the 'Restrict to roles' field?

options.text: Enable responsive dashboards on the instance
Share the dashboard with the intended users first
Create a custom ACL for the dashboard

explanation.correct: You must share the dashboard before you can restrict access to specified roles. Restricting access to specific roles is not the same as sharing — users must be shared with AND have the restricted role.

wrongAnswers.explanation: While responsive dashboards must be enabled for the field to appear, sharing is the prerequisite action.
Restrict to roles works with any PA installation.
Dashboard restrictions use the built-in Restrict to roles field, not custom ACLs.

questions.question: Which role is required to add or remove Performance Analytics widgets on a dashboard?

explanation.correct: The ability to add Performance Analytics widgets to dashboards requires at least the pa_power_user role. Users with pa_admin and admin roles can also do this.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Users with any role can create dashboards but cannot add PA widgets without pa_power_user.
itil alone does not grant permission to add PA widgets.
dashboard_admin can edit dashboards but pa_power_user is the minimum for PA widgets specifically.

questions.question: How are ACLs applied to Performance Analytics widgets on dashboards?

options.text: ACLs are enforced on all PA widgets the same as other widget types
ACLs are NOT applied to PA widgets; any user who can view the dashboard can view all PA widgets
ACLs are applied only to PA widgets showing list data
ACLs are applied based on the widget creator's permissions

explanation.correct: ACLs are not applied to Performance Analytics widgets added to dashboards. Any user who can view a dashboard can view all its PA widgets. However, real-time scores depend on the logged-in user's roles and ACLs of the facts table.

wrongAnswers.explanation: PA widgets are explicitly exempt from standard widget ACLs on dashboards.
PA widgets are completely exempt from ACLs on dashboards, regardless of data type.
Widget creator permissions do not affect PA widget ACL behavior.

questions.question: Which two users can delete a responsive dashboard? (Choose two.)

options.text: Any user the dashboard has been shared with

explanation.correct: Only the dashboard owner and users with the dashboard_admin or admin role can delete a dashboard.

wrongAnswers.explanation: pa_power_user can manage PA widgets but cannot delete dashboards they don't own.
Being shared on a dashboard does not grant deletion permissions.

questions.question: What happens to dashboard access when Explicit Roles are activated on an instance?

options.text: All dashboards require the admin role to view
Dashboards are treated as internal resources; users with snc_external role cannot view them by default
Dashboard sharing is disabled for all non-admin users
All existing dashboard permissions are reset

explanation.correct: When Explicit Roles are activated, dashboards are treated as internal resources. Users with the snc_external role cannot view dashboards by default.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Dashboards don't require admin; they're just classified as internal resources.
Sharing is not disabled; external users are restricted by default.
Existing permissions are not reset.

questions.question: What content does the Performance Analytics Admin Console NOT support?

explanation.correct: The Admin Console does not support Platform Analytics artifacts. It shows information only for Core UI Performance Analytics widgets and responsive dashboards.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Core UI PA widgets are supported by the Admin Console.
Responsive dashboards are supported.
Data collection job monitoring is available through the Troubleshoot and Usage panels.
